recommendation: Have Pharmacy and Terminology Infrastructure resolve UP-555 or a core follow-up with exact code values, displays, definitions, and guidance for the relationship to inpatient/outpatient/community categories. Once settled, add those concepts to source/medicationrequest/codesystem-medicationrequest-category.xml.
issue_request: FHIR-36027 asked for MedicationUsage/MedicationStatement.category support to declare medications as pre-op, intra-op, and post-op; the Applied/Persuasive resolution said the category value set would be updated with the three requested values.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-36027 source commit was found. Pharmacy voted the issue Persuasive in March 2022, UP-555 later attempted a UTG terminology update, and FHIR-51726/PR #3896 moved the medicationrequest-category CodeSystem/ValueSet back into FHIR Core and rebound MedicationStatement.category, but did not add pre-op, intra-op, or post-op concepts.
additional_context: Current MedicationStatement.category is example-bound to the core medicationrequest-category ValueSet, whose CodeSystem contains inpatient, outpatient, community, and discharge only. UP-555 is still Proposal Draft/Unresolved and contains unresolved concerns about overlap, example-code-system use, and the unclear proposed intra display; Pharmacy and TI minutes show the direction is real but still needs a terminology decision now that the CodeSystem is back in core.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. Adding concepts now would require inventing code values, displays, definitions, and overlap guidance that the unresolved UP-555 trail explicitly left unsettled.
